hooks.text: 只需移动并利用自动开火武器的弹道规律清扫鱼群
hooks.excerpt: The gameplay is simple, just move, and use the patterns of the auto-firing weapons you have to murder the oncoming swarms of fishies & creatures.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 扮演虾收集微塑料，购买移速、生命、伤害与减伤的局外升级
hooks.excerpt: A shrimple survivor-like where you play as a shrimp, you must kill fishies & other creatures, gather microplastics, and purchase meta upgrades. Current Meta Upgrades: +5% Move Speed - 4 Levels +10% Max Health - 5 Levels +5% Outgoing Damage - 5 Levels -1 Incoming Damage - 3 Levels

hooks.text: 通过免费掉落获取不同稀有度的虾皮肤与帽子
hooks.excerpt: Free Item Drops are in... Customize your shrimp! The Drop-rates are as follows: 80% - for a shrimp skin (split to 99% common rarity skin, and 1% rare rarity skin) 19% - for a unique rarity hat 1% - for a rare rarity hat.
